data.exact_reserve_text: The gross prior year development for the 2016 underwriting year is derived from the 'Gross outstanding claims provision at 31 December 2018' table on page 14, calculated as the difference between the 'Current estimate of cumulative claims incurred' (93,806k) and the '12 months later' estimate (75,436k) for 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 18.37 million, primarily attributable to the 2016 underwriting year as derived from the claims development table. This adverse development is consistent with the overall adverse effect on the result for the year due to catastrophe losses in 2018, including Hurricanes Florence and Michael and Californian wildfires, for which reserves were established. Additionally, the 2015 underwriting year closed with a net loss of GBP 13.257 million, indicating further prior year strengthening for older periods.
raw_causal_phrases: Much of the growth was in the Property insurance and reinsurance classes and due mainly to the catastrophe losses in 2018 this has had an adverse effect on the result for the year.

Both 2017 and 2018 were also affected by catastrophe losses and reserves have been established in 2018 for Hurricanes Florence and Michael as well as the Californian wildfires ($100.8m gross and $27.4m net).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 18.37 million is derived from the gross claims development table for the 2016 underwriting year only, as per instructions to exclude the two most recent underwriting years (2017 and 2018) from prior year development calculations from the triangle. The report also states a net loss of GBP 13.257 million for the 2015 & prior year of account results, which is a prior year movement not included in the gross figure due to the 'MUST be GROSS' instruction.
